# AtmosShield

The atmospheric shield hardsuit protects its wearer from pressure and temperature extremes while active. Its toggle
projects the Medusa personal shield's animated bubble and grants pressure immunity to the wearer. Damage from another
entity disengages the shield.

Entry points: `WFClothingOuterHardsuitAtmosShield`, `WFAtmosShieldComponent`, and
`WFAtmosShieldSystem`.
